name: Multi-Stage Lithium-Ion Battery Aging Dataset
description: Experimental Li-ion aging dataset built with multiple design-of-experiment methodologies: 280 files (10.3 GB) of cycling/aging measurements across stages and conditions. Deposited with the Scientific Data descriptor (2024).
associated_paper: 'A multi-stage lithium-ion battery aging dataset using various experimental design methodologies', Sci. Data (2024), doi:10.1038/s41597-024-03859-z

name: In-Situ PEM Fuel Cell Cathode Catalyst Degradation Dataset
description: Experimental in-situ characterization of cathode catalyst degradation in proton-exchange-membrane fuel cells: 51 files (851 MB) of electrochemical and characterization data with analysis scripts. Scientific Data descriptor (2024).
associated_paper: 'In-Situ Characterization of Cathode Catalyst Degradation in PEM Fuel Cells', Sci. Data (2024), doi:10.1038/s41597-024-03662-w

name: Multidimensional Photoemission Spectra of WSe2
description: Measured multidimensional (time/angle-resolved) photoemission spectroscopy data of tungsten diselenide: 6.2 GB HDF5 volumes released with an open-source end-to-end workflow for multidimensional photoemission spectroscopy. Scientific Data (2020).
associated_paper: 'An open-source, end-to-end workflow for multidimensional photoemission spectroscopy', Sci. Data (2020), doi:10.1038/s41597-020-00769-8

name: LIBS Benchmark Classification Dataset
description: Benchmark dataset of measured laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy (LIBS) spectra for classification: 7.6 GB HDF5 training set (plus test set) covering many sample classes, released as a Scientific Data descriptor (2020). CC0.
associated_paper: 'Benchmark classification dataset for laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy', Sci. Data (2020), doi:10.1038/s41597-020-0396-8

name: Battery Materials Database (ChemDataExtractor, Huang & Cole)
description: Literature-mined database of experimentally reported battery material properties auto-generated with ChemDataExtractor: ~292,000 records (capacity, voltage, conductivity, Coulombic efficiency, energy density) extracted from ~229,000 papers. Scientific Data (2020).
associated_paper: Huang & Cole, 'A database of battery materials auto-generated using ChemDataExtractor', Sci. Data (2020), doi:10.1038/s41597-020-00602-2
